purpose: Bounded independent primary-event audit and receipt-date historical valuation of TLA incentive-addition fees. Gross fee-interest cashflow only; no asserted damage, personal net income, wrongdoing, or legal entitlement.

scope.coverage_limit: Complete for the 95 returned transactions and matching successful top-level transfer events in the saved query. Not a proof that the endpoint index captured every lifetime fee, beneficiary or onward movement.

current_config_fee_10_LUNA.temporal_limit: State captured 17 October 2026; historical fee amount independently corroborated by each actual transfer, not inferred backward from config alone.

historical_fee_collector_change.meaning: Successful address-setting instruction; does not alone establish lawful entitlement or personal ownership.

classification_support.term_note: The contract action is technically named bribe/add_bribe. Here this means adding voting incentives; the name alone is not evidence of criminal bribery.
classification_support.fee_recipient_identity_limit: Existing investigation associates the recipient with Philipp professionally. This audit proves transfers to the exact account, not exclusive personal control, civil identity, beneficial entitlement, retained profit, or a compensable loss.

pricing_method.formula: Each exact LUNA amount × Binance LUNAUSDT hourly close × Coinbase Exchange USDT-USD close for the same hour.
pricing_method.hour_selection: Immediately preceding fully completed UTC hourly candle. Every selected candle has positive volume and positive close on both exchanges; no fallback or interpolation needed.
pricing_method.price_precision: Decimal arithmetic; sum exact unrounded event values; round final and monthly display totals to USD cents, half-up. LUNA token count does not depend on price.
pricing_method.limits: Historical market reference at receipt; no proof of actual sale proceeds, liquidity-adjusted realizability, taxes, costs or net income.
pricing_method.new_capture_hash_scope: New responses are embedded verbatim as body_text with their UTF-8 byte SHA-256; body_json is a parsed convenience copy. Embedded response hashes do not purport to hash the enclosing audit JSON.

deduplication.comparison_scope: All canonical organization receipts plus all historical and later Eris valuation records, including classifications excluded from the old fee total. Exact physical key and a second check omitting event/coin indices.
deduplication.limit: Zero physical duplication establishes distinct captured transfers at this stage. It does not establish economic independence from grant funding or authorize adding downstream redistributions, project grants, company receipts, or personal-net-income estimates.

presentation_recommendation_de: Gesonderter Gebührenzufluss: In 95 erfolgreichen Transaktionen vom 1. Oktober 2025 bis 12. Oktober 2026 sind 228 einzelne Überweisungen von jeweils 10 LUNA, insgesamt 2.280 LUNA, vom TLA-Incentive-Vertrag an die untersuchte Gebührenadresse nachgewiesen. Ihr historischer Marktvergleichswert beträgt insgesamt 159.95 USD. In den bisherigen Gebührenregistern wurde keine identische Zahlung gefunden. Die Summe beziffert ein untersuchbares Gebühreninteresse; sie ist keine bezifferte Schadensforderung und kein nachgewiesener persönlicher Nettogewinn.
